nodes.label: Kunal Dovedy
nodes.subtitle: Connected Creativity
nodes.summary: Interactive artist and digital transformation leader in San Francisco. One line holds the whole practice together: he designs products, advises digital transformation, builds collaborative teams, and creates interactive art and music.

nodes.label: Connected Creativity
nodes.subtitle: The banner over all of it
nodes.summary: Creativity is not a solo act. The work is worth doing when it connects people to each other, and connects the technical to the human.

nodes.label: Enhance humanity
nodes.subtitle: The test a project has to pass
nodes.summary: Dovedy LLC was founded for multidisciplinary projects meant to enhance humanity. That is the filter: does this leave people better off.

nodes.label: Information is greater than control
nodes.subtitle: Decision making comes before preventing bad outcomes
nodes.summary: A stated value of Sierra Technology, in its own words: it "places the sovereignty of decision making before limiting undesired scenarios." Give people what they need to decide rather than narrowing what they are allowed to do.

nodes.label: Data transparency
nodes.subtitle: Trust is downstream of access
nodes.summary: A stated value of Sierra Technology, in its own words: it "increases trust in the company, by making data immediate, available, and usable."

nodes.label: Freeing humans with automation
nodes.subtitle: Automation is for people, not instead of them
nodes.summary: A stated value of Sierra Technology, in its own words: it "delivers more time and energy to people by freeing them from repetitive, monotonous, error-prone work."

nodes.label: Innovation at the edge
nodes.subtitle: New things start where the people are
nodes.summary: A stated value of Sierra Technology, in its own words: it "creates an environment to allow for innovation take place at the people-focused areas of the company." Not in a central lab, at the edge where the work happens.

nodes.label: Knowledge shared, not hoarded
nodes.subtitle: The open source movement, as a way of thinking
nodes.summary: In his own words: "I feel motivated and inspired by those who innovate and share their knowledge with those who need it. I feel that this method of thinking is very much like the open source movement, of which I have the utmost respect."

nodes.label: Build the team, not the hero
nodes.subtitle: Capability over dependency
nodes.summary: Success looks like a group that can carry on without him. His own public description of the work is to "build highly collaborative teams", and he confirmed this framing of why.

nodes.label: Play is the doorway
nodes.subtitle: Discovery before instruction
nodes.summary: At Burning Man 2013 nobody handed out instructions. Participants worked out how to play a jet engine by dropping ball bearings into it. Curiosity did the teaching.

nodes.label: Machines can sing
nodes.subtitle: Repurpose, do not scrap
nodes.summary: A compressor that pushed an F-4 Phantom past Mach 2 now rings like a set of tuning forks. Hard engineering can be turned toward wonder.

nodes.label: Designing products
nodes.subtitle: From a vague need to a thing that ships
nodes.summary: First on his own list: "Design products." Product design across digital customer experience, which at Sierra reaches the client as rapid prototyping: working applications built fast enough to test against the business case rather than argue about.

nodes.label: Advising digital transformation
nodes.subtitle: Changing how an organisation works, not just its tools
nodes.summary: Second on his own list: "Advise digital transformation." Guiding organisations through systemic change with technology. The current seat is Senior Director of Digital Customer Experience Transformation at Ralliant; the consulting seat is Sierra Technology.

nodes.label: Building highly collaborative teams
nodes.subtitle: The durable deliverable
nodes.summary: Third on his own list: "Build highly collaborative teams." Assembling and leading teams across functions, countries and time zones, so that the capability stays after the project ends.

nodes.label: Enabling information transparency
nodes.subtitle: Making the organisation able to see itself
nodes.summary: Fourth on his own list: "Enable information transparency." At Sierra this is a named service: define the data strategy, then architect and develop the infrastructure needed to democratize the data. The value underneath it is that information beats control.

nodes.label: Creating interactive art and music
nodes.subtitle: Where strangers become collaborators
nodes.summary: Fifth on his own list: "Create interactive art & music." Large scale interactive sound art, made to be played by whoever walks up to it.

nodes.label: Digital customer experience strategy
nodes.summary: Designing the whole path a customer takes through a company, then rebuilding the digital parts of it.

nodes.label: Systemic change leadership
nodes.summary: Moving a large organisation from one operating model to another, including the parts that are politics rather than technology.

nodes.label: IT and service operations leadership
nodes.summary: Running information technology for facilities and field service businesses. Director of Information Technology at ServiceChannel and at Gordian.

nodes.label: Film and media production
nodes.summary: A BA in Film and Media Studies from UC Santa Barbara, plus screen credits in additional crew, visual effects and sound department.

nodes.label: Distributed production management
nodes.summary: Coordinating graphics and animation teams, translators and transcribers across six countries to a single release.

nodes.label: Digital engagement and growth strategy
nodes.summary: Building demand for a professional services practice in a new market. An MBA in Marketing and Technology sits behind it.

nodes.label: Heavy fabrication and repurposing
nodes.summary: Taking industrial hardware apart and rebuilding it as something people can touch. The J79 compressor is the proof.

nodes.label: Sound and web audio programming
nodes.summary: Interactive sound in the browser. The public cadence repository is built on Tone.js and web components.

nodes.label: Facilitation and coaching
nodes.summary: Getting a room of people with different incentives to agree on one next step.

nodes.label: Rapid prototyping
nodes.summary: A named Sierra Technology service: build working digital applications fast enough to test them against the business case.

nodes.label: Data strategy and architecture
nodes.summary: A named Sierra Technology service: define the data strategy, then architect and develop the infrastructure needed to democratize the data.

nodes.label: Solution advisory
nodes.summary: A named Sierra Technology service: which technologies are practical to adopt, and how they fit the systems a company already runs.

nodes.label: The Turbinophone
nodes.subtitle: A jet engine you play with ball bearings
nodes.summary: A J79 turbojet compressor, taken from an engine that pushed an F-4 Phantom past Mach 2 on 17,000 pounds of thrust, rebuilt as a collaborative musical instrument. Drop a steel ball bearing in the top. It strikes the blades, which ring like tuning forks. The blades get shorter on the way down, so the pitch rises as the bearing falls.
